neighbours.label: ' behind' in the sense of trailing in a ranking or comparison ("is still behind in X"), not spatial 'behind'
fire: Compared with Denmark, Finland is slightly behind in offshore wind capacity.
In broadband coverage the region is still well behind the national average.
Although wages have risen, Portugal is behind by roughly a decade.
Among the four carmakers, the oldest one is clearly behind in battery research.
On literacy the northern districts are still far behind the capital.
Compared with its rivals, the startup is somewhat behind in sales.
In vaccination rates the province is behind by several percentage points.
Despite heavy spending, the navy is still behind its competitors in submarine technology.
quiet: The children were hiding behind the shed when the rain started.
Compared with Denmark, Finland is slightly ahead in offshore wind capacity.
She parked the van behind the bakery and unloaded the flour.
In broadband coverage the region now matches the national average.
He left his umbrella behind the door of the classroom.
Among the four carmakers, the oldest one spends the most on battery research.
A long queue formed behind the ticket counter before the show.
On literacy the northern districts have caught up with the capital.

notes: Card flags the pole broad; top examples are mixed evaluative/standing words (decisive, best, took the first set). Probes: comparative-standing 'behind' 0.32-0.56, spatial 'behind' 0.02, 'ahead' 0.06. The label covers only this slice.
